description: Implementation of the egl::Display interface for macOS using CGL, including context creation, surface management, extension generation, and GPU handling.

classes.name: FunctionsGLCGL
classes.description: Handles loading OpenGL functions dynamically via a dylib handle.

classes.name: DisplayCGL
classes.description: Implements egl::Display for macOS using CGL, managing contexts, surfaces, extensions, and GPU switching.

classes.name: WorkerContextCGL
classes.description: Represents a worker OpenGL context for CGL, managing context creation and current state.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the display, creates pixel format and context, and checks for GPU switching support.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Cleans up and releases CGL resources.

methods.name: createWindowSurface
methods.description: Creates a window surface for rendering.

methods.name: createPbufferSurface
methods.description: Creates a pixel buffer surface.

methods.name: createPbufferFromClientBuffer
methods.description: Creates a surface from a client buffer, specifically IOSurface.

methods.name: createPixmapSurface
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to create a pixmap surface.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates an OpenGL context, with support for discrete GPU if requested.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a device object for CGL.

methods.name: generateConfigs
methods.description: Generates EGL configurations supported by the display.

methods.name: testDeviceLost
methods.description: Placeholder for device loss detection.

methods.name: restoreLostDevice
methods.description: Unimplemented; intended to restore device after loss.

methods.name: isValidNativeWindow
methods.description: Checks if a native window handle is valid.

methods.name: validateClientBuffer
methods.description: Validates client buffer attributes.

methods.name: getVendorString
methods.description: Returns vendor string; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: getCGLContext
methods.description: Returns the current CGL context.

methods.name: getCGLPixelFormat
methods.description: Returns the current CGL pixel format.

methods.name: generateExtensions
methods.description: Populates supported extension list.

methods.name: generateCaps
methods.description: Sets capabilities like NPOT textures.

methods.name: waitClient
methods.description: Placeholder for waiting on client operations.

methods.name: waitNative
methods.description: Placeholder for waiting on native operations.

methods.name: getMaxSupportedESVersion
methods.description: Returns maximum supported OpenGL ES version.

methods.name: makeCurrentSurfaceless
methods.description: Makes the context current without a surface.
